compatibility: B30 is additive and opt-in. Existing routes and equal/more-specific SPAs retain precedence, including exclusions. No new reserved-prefix policy is introduced.

B31 changes exported framework bridge signatures involving internal seals as a documented security correction. Normal application APIs, generated declarations, persisted data and wire formats are unchanged.
Unknown database wrappers, including embedding wrappers, cannot prove observer absence. Per-model writes use supplied transactions; set-based writes need existing WithoutModelHooks acknowledgement.
Relation container slices are copied; contained models retain ordinary Go value-copy semantics.

checks.result: Full requested command passed with required local listener access; unchanged packages used normal Go test caching.

changelog:
- Add `AssetMount.WithNavigationFallback(net/http.Handler)` for missing HTML
  navigations inside mount middleware, and export the shared
  `http.IsHTMLNavigation` predicate. Existing assets, typed JSON errors, route
  and SPA precedence, and SPA exclusions retain their behavior. The handler
  owns its response and receives no mount cache headers.
- Validate distinct framework capabilities for observer metadata, autocommit
  queries, statement outcomes, relation collections and error diagnostics.
  Inferred zero seals fail closed; concrete ownership checks prevent application
  wrappers from capturing capabilities. Unknown database wrappers count as
  observed; previously supported concrete pointer/value owner forms remain
  recognized. Pure adapter markers remain no-ops with no capability.
- Copy relation loader input slices before publishing collections and links.
  Normal caller APIs and generated/persisted formats are unchanged; internal-seal
  bridge signatures are a documented security correction. See
  [compatibility](docs/compatibility.md#validated-framework-capabilities-b31).
final_review: Reviewed the former observerOwner declarations and receiver method sets: DB/Session/Tx supported pointers only, PrimaryExecutor/enclosingTransaction supported values and pointers. Both missing pointer forms now have concrete cases and nil guards; regressions cover observer absence and update/delete lifecycle admission for all seven forms. Application capture protections remain intact. All requested acceptance commands passed on this revision.

review_followup.finding: Accepted Medium: concrete observer lookup omitted *database.PrimaryExecutor and *enclosingTransaction, both supported by the former observerOwner interface.
review_followup.fix: Added both concrete pointer forms with nil guards, preserving capability isolation.
review_followup.regression: TestObserverLookupPreservesFrameworkOwnerForms covers *DB, PrimaryExecutor, *PrimaryExecutor, *Session, *Tx, enclosingTransaction, *enclosingTransaction; each must prove absence and permit update/delete lifecycle checks without WithoutModelHooks. Typed nil owners remain unknown.
